_source: Allegrini et al., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 51 (2022), Table 8 (210Fr w.a. / Coc, Grossman). Sansonetti, JPCRD 36, 497 (2007).
_isotope: Fr-210 (I=6; MOT isotope — Simsarian et al. PRL 76, 3522)
_note: Run with: python hyperfine.py Fr --isotope 210. Fr has no stable isotope; hyperfine.py otherwise picks the longest-lived entry in nuclear_data.json. Fr-223 (longest-lived / only natural isotope) has partial D-line data only: A(7s)=7654(2) MHz, A(7p3/2)=83.3(9), B(7p3/2)=308(3) MHz (Coc / Sansonetti); 7p1/2 is not available in the standard compilations, so 210Fr is used as the complete D1+D2 set.
